premise.claim: On the base branch, fake.NewClientset() (the field-managed fake) rejects every Create/Update/Patch/Apply of an RBG object with "no type found matching: io.k8s.sigs.rbgs.api.workloads.v1alpha2.RoleBasedGroup", while seeding and Get work.

findings.claim: The OpenAPI schema embedded in client-go/applyconfiguration/internal/internal.go is derived from the Go API types, but kube-apiserver builds its server-side-apply schema from the CRDs in config/crd/bases, which declare x-kubernetes-preserve-unknown-fields on the component/instance pod-template subtrees (and the template patches). Under the server schema those subtrees are tracked with deduced semantics (maps per key, lists as a whole); under the embedded schema they are fully typed (containers keyed by name). The generated Extract<Kind> helpers interpret server-recorded managed fields with the embedded schema, so they drop the schemaless subtree content, and an extract -> modify -> apply cycle deletes those fields from the live object.

v1alpha1 InstanceSpec.Components: the CRD declares no x-kubernetes-list-type, so the API server tracks the list atomically (replaced as a whole), but the embedded schema emits a merge-by-name associative list from the +patchStrategy=merge/+patchMergeKey=name comment markers added by this PR. The generated ExtractInstance drops the components the manager applied, and the field-managed fake clientset merges components by name where the API server replaces the list.

The PR description describes a different revision than the head commit b719f3c8: it claims tests in internal/clientgo (8 tests, parity with kube-apiserver), that pkg/generated/openapi and the +k8s:openapi-gen markers are gone, that the schema is built from config/crd/bases via BuildOpenAPIV3/MergeSpecsV3, that internal.go is ~57.6k lines, and that vendor/ adds the apiextensions-apiserver builder. None of that is present at the head: pkg/generated/openapi is added (23k lines), internal.go is 4.3k lines, and the only tests are in pkg/generated/openapi. The body itself documents that this first-revision approach loses data ("The first revision of this PR had exactly this problem").
findings.evidence: git diff 98d3c4be..b719f3c8 --stat and the PR body

liveNote: L3 (live cluster) was intentionally skipped per the review round policy; the L1/L2 layers use the same field-management code the API server runs (k8s.io/apimachinery/pkg/util/managedfields), and the hand-rolled CRD model construction was cross-validated against k8s.io/apiextensions-apiserver builder.BuildOpenAPIV3 + MergeSpecsV3 in docs/verification/clientgo-apply-schema/crosscheck (results/real-apiserver-crosscheck.txt).
